name: Fania
text: Fania pls grab the keyz from the lockbox tonite, the code still wont work on the south door. thx, leave them in the plant pot

name: Jezdimirovic
text: Jezdimirovic chek the rota again plz, i swapped wiv one of the lads for the late shift but my name is still on the old one. the sheet in the office is wrong too so its not just me

name: van der Boom
text: van der Boom the storeroom light is still flickering so ive put a note on the door, can u chek if the new tubes came in, the last lot were the wrong size n we sent em back. the fitting is the old type btw, i left the box by the noticeboard

name: Segi Staberock
text: Segi Staberock the till roll ran out again mid queue, can u bring a box over b4 the lunch rush plz

name: Eloy
text: Eloy my badge wont scan at the side gate, security say the chip is dead. can u sort a new one b4 tomorow, i need it for the early open else im stuck outside again

name: Spiekerman
text: Spiekerman the printer on 2 keeps eating pages, ive cleared the tray n reseated it twice. if it jams again were better off using the one by the stairs, its slower but at least it works. the repair guy is booked for friday anyway so maybe just wait it out

name: Sines Rüya
text: Sines Rüya the milk in the staff fridge is off again, can u chuck it n grab a new one on ur way in

name: Jennefer Shiny
text: Jennefer Shiny the meeting room is double booked at 3, can u check whose name is on it first. if its the finance lot we can just move to the cafe

name: Szimonetta
text: Szimonetta the fire door by the loading bay is propped open again, ive shut it twice this week. if it keeps happening we need to tape the latch n call maintenance. the keypad on the other door is knackered too so ppl keep using this one as a shortcut

name: Fridelj
text: Fridelj the van has a flat again, same tyre as last time. can u ring the garage on ur break

name: Awaj Novok-Rostás
text: Awaj Novok-Rostás the pigeon is back in the yard, ive blocked the gap under the pallets but it found another way in. any ideas. it was sat on the fork lift this morning like it owns the place

name: Cid López
text: Cid López the shower in the west block runs cold after 5 min, ive logged it with the office. the plumber came last month n said it was fine but its clearly not. two of the lads have given up n just use the one upstairs now, so it needs a proper look

name: Scilanga
text: Scilanga the gate fob stopped working yday, can u re program it when ur at the desk next. its the spare one from the drawer

name: Nedjip
text: Nedjip arrived at the depot before six and found the shutter jammed half open. He rang the duty manager, then waited with the van until the fitter could free it. The delivery went out late but no stock was lost.

name: Menea
text: Menea took the call from the freight company and noted the revised arrival window in the log. The driver had been rerouted because of roadworks on the bypass. Nothing on the manifest changed so the unloading plan stayed as it was. The bay was booked for eight giving the crew a clear hour before the shift change.

name: Neliya Carmen Algel
text: Neliya Carmen Algel was first through the door when the sale opened and headed straight for the coats rail. She found the last size ten within a minute.

name: Secondo Kehl
text: Secondo Kehl reported the blocked drain behind the canteen and showed the caretaker where the water pooled. The rodding crew arrived after lunch and cleared it in an hour. The yard was hosed down before the evening rush.

name: Driton
text: Driton walked the perimeter at dusk and found the side gate swinging loose on its hinge. He propped it shut with a pallet and logged the fault on the tablet. The night guard was told to keep the yard light on until the repair. A joiner was booked for the morning.

name: Dunkley
text: Dunkley took the minutes at the residents meeting and typed them up the same evening. The next meeting is set for March.

name: El Hamous Daurelle
text: El Hamous Daurelle chaired the handover and walked the new starters through the weekend schedule. Two of them had not seen the alarm codes, so the office emailed a reminder. The rota was pinned before the end of the shift.

name: Karunaivel Chetan
text: Karunaivel Chetan spotted the water damage in the archive room and moved the boxes to the corridor before it spread. Samples were marked with the date and photographed. The landlord was told the leak came through the roof. A drying unit was ordered for the corner.

name: Ouiza
text: Ouiza helped stack the delivery cages before the rain set in. The driver left a note about a missing pallet.

name: Kosovic
text: Kosovic took over the desk at noon and sorted the backlog of missed calls. Three were from the same supplier, so one callback covered them. The log was updated by half past.

name: Canije Karaçi
text: Canije Karaçi ran the induction for the two new lab assistants and set them up on the door system. Both were shown the spill kit cupboard and the waste route. The fire briefing was moved to the afternoon so the morning samples were not delayed. Badges were ready by three.

name: Tiaro Battilocchi
text: Tiaro Battilocchi called the IT desk about the till going offline mid transaction. The reset worked. A spare till was moved to the front for the rest of the day.

name: Darragi
text: Darragi covered the early round alone because the second driver called in sick. The route was finished by nine with no missed stops. The depot asked for a note to confirm.

name: Iegor
text: right so the meeting moved to 2 and nobody told the guys on the night shift, ive texted Iegor n hes gonna pass it on. we still need the numbers for the deck tho, ive chased em twice. also the back door code changed again ffs

name: Boves
text: the sink in the back is leaking again ugh, Boves had a look n said the seal is done. can someone book the plumber

name: Brhane Meschinet
text: the quiz night is on again thursday n were one team short, Brhane Meschinet said they might join if the babysitter comes thru. can u confirm by wednesday so we can book the table

name: Marie-Noelle Dumenia Sarfels
text: the choir swapped to the small hall becos the heating is broke in the big one, Marie-Noelle Dumenia Sarfels is bringing the extra chairs tonite. we still need someone on the door from 6 tho, n the song sheets are in the cupboard. if nobody steps up ill do first half n swap after

name: Arzan
text: the wifi in the flat keeps dropping since the storm, Arzan reset the router twice already. openreach coming tuesday. hopefully that sorts it

name: Abgottspon
text: the tool crib is a state again, someone put the torque wrench back without the case. Abgottspon says the calibration sticker is missing, can u have a word b4 the audit

name: Mc Ardle
text: the order for the new chairs finally showed up but two legs are bent. the supplier says its on us becos Mc Ardle signed for it without checking, can you sort a claim plz, they want photos n the delivery note. the boxes are still in the hall if u need shots of the labels

name: Padeiro Piening
text: the toastie machine is tripping the socket at the back, Padeiro Piening thinks its the old plug. can maintenance swap it

name: Pabla
text: the delivery for the promo stand is booked for tuesday between 8 n 12, Pabla will meet them at the side entrance n sign it off. the passes are in the drawer by the till

name: Reinstadler
text: the skip is getting swapped friday so anything for the tip needs to be out by thursday night, Reinstadler is doing a run in the van first thing. dont put paint tins in it tho, they have to go to the depot. the last lot got refused at the gate n we had to bring it back

name: al Homsi
text: the pool table in the common room has a ripped cloth, al Homsi says the pub down the road still has tables free. maybe move game night

name: Bekon Mihill
text: the christmas do deposit is due friday n weve only got half, Bekon Mihill is chasing the rest at the desk. if it doesnt clear we lose the room so pls bring cash tomorow

name: Uthayakumari
text: The facilities team cleared the basement over two days, then emptied the old racks room by room. Uthayakumari labelled every storage cage before the new shelving arrived on Friday. Nothing went out without a photo record. The room is ready for the archive move, next up is the corridor by the plant room.

name: Gualzata
text: The order came in short yet again, so Gualzata counted the pallets twice before signing. Two cases were missing. The driver blamed the depot.

name: Nik Rapphold Daul
text: The gate camera failed overnight and the guard wrote the visitors down by hand. Nik Rapphold Daul checked the entries against the sign in book in the morning and found two gaps.

name: Georgakopoulou Soeiro Agushaj
text: The site office passed the parking complaint to the facilities team, and Georgakopoulou Soeiro Agushaj reviewed the permits for the whole row. Three had expired in the spring and were never renewed. Letters went out on Tuesday. The barrier list was updated once the new stickers were collected.

name: Natthaphon
text: The new starter shadowed the till for the morning, and Natthaphon signed off the till counts at the close. All matched.

name: Damyanliev
text: The samples went out with the courier before noon, and Damyanliev logged the tracking numbers into the system. Two results came back early. The rest are due by Friday, the lab confirmed by email.

name: Polzella Althuizen
text: The treasurer counted the takings from the choir concert with the help of Polzella Althuizen before the hall was locked. The float was returned to the safe. A short note went on the board thanking the helpers, and the next fundraiser is pencilled in for the spring fete at the same venue.

name: De Genua
text: The shutters jammed on the west entrance, and De Genua called the keyholder to open up the side. The rush passed with no queue.

name: Laurena
text: The van came back from the garage with a fresh service, and Laurena checked the paperwork against the invoice before filing it. The next service is due in the autumn. The courtesy car was returned the same day.

name: Pandiani
text: The two vans arrived at nine and the team started with the heavy boxes. Pandiani supervised the loading and checked every label at the door. The office was swept and the keys handed back before lunch. A photo list of the new shelving went to the records team.

name: Sara Steinfort
text: The missing parcel turned up behind the recycling bin, and Sara Steinfort logged it as found on the tracking sheet. The customer was told.

name: Tijda Trappa
text: The rota for the bank holiday came out late and Tijda Trappa swapped two shifts so the desk stayed covered. Everyone got the hours they asked for. The changes were posted on the board and emailed to the team.
